responses.description: Switching Protocols; then the subscribe protocol (handlers.ws_quotes)

notes: Auth is checked by the handler on connect from ?api_key only: accept, then close 4401 with reason 'Missing api_key query parameter.' / 'Invalid API key.' / 'This API key has been revoked.' (000827-000834). readonly-key may subscribe (000830).

Client sends {action: subscribe, symbols: [...]}: ack {type: subscribed, symbols (uppercased, deduplicated)}, then 5 rounds ~250 ms apart of {type: quote, symbol, price, as_of} per symbol in order, then {type: done} and close 1000.
Errors are {type: error, message} and keep the socket open; messages sent while streaming are never answered (000826). Not rate limited (000812/000814).
Market-open values (price/as_of while a session is open) follow the REST quote (docs: as_of = now - 1.5 s); only closed-market sessions were recorded (weekend).

Binary frames -> {type: error, message: 'Binary messages are not supported.'}, socket stays open; plain HTTP GET -> 404 not_found (observed by the independent review, not recorded: the recorder sends text frames only).

error.message: Missing API key. Send it in the X-API-Key header.
This API key has been revoked.
Rate limit exceeded: 30 requests per 10 seconds.

notes: Auth: X-API-Key. Real demo keys: demo-key (full), readonly-key (GET only; writes -> 403 read_only_key), revoked-key (403 api_key_revoked, no rate-limit headers). The fake runs in allowlist mode with these users (see .env.example).
Every /v1 path (also unknown /v1 routes and 405s) authenticates first, then counts against the rate limit; their responses carry X-RateLimit-* headers. /healthz and non-/v1 paths need no key.
Routing: case-sensitive; trailing slash -> 404 not_found; 405 carries Allow (GET / GET, POST).

Rate limit: 30/10 s per key, fixed window from the first request (docs + recorded headers). The 429 body {code rate_limited, message 'Rate limit exceeded: 30 requests per 10 seconds.'} and Retry-After: 10 were observed by the independent review (31-GET burst with readonly-key, 2026-10-11), not recorded: the recorder paces calls and rate-limit probing was not separately approved. The limit applies before the read-only check.

WS /v1/ws/quotes (documented in the API description only; data/source/ws-quotes.openapi.json) is faked from recordings 000810-000845 by handlers.ws_quotes. The MCP server at /mcp is out of scope (answers.json).

Under /v1, writes (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) with readonly-key get 403 read_only_key even on unknown routes and 405 paths: the read-only check runs after auth and rate limit, before routing (independent review, 2026-10-11).
